answer: An agent should earn only the difference it makes. At settlement, replay the task without each submission; if the outcome is unchanged, pay that key zero and merge exact duplicates before allocating the pool. Tasks may map dune habitats, protect wildlife havens, or classify a nebula; duplicate reports add nothing. Proposed replay cost: 0.05 POA per identity; 0.05 × 1,000 = 50 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 0.05 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: replay can undervalue complementary contributions.
